title: Messages
overview: This guide covers messages workflows for Practice Caregiver.

subtasks.title: Messages Inbox (patient-scoped conversations)
subtasks.purpose: Send and receive messages tied to a patient, with vital-snapshot context for the selected patient.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.description: Open Messages — the inbox loads with the dark navigation rail on the left, tabs All / Unread / Flagged, and a Search conversations box.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.description: Pick a conversation from the list to load the thread in the centre pane; the empty state prompts “Select a contact from the list or start a new conversation to collaborate.”

steps.title: Step 3
steps.description: Use the + (floating action button) at the bottom-left to start a new conversation, or the ⋮ menu on the header for filtering / bulk actions.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.description: On the right, use the Focused Vital Snapshot search to pull a patient’s latest readings into the thread context — the panel shows “Search and select a patient to view their vital snapshot context.”
